images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original sample photograph for a fictional browser photo darkroom, also used as a large editorial website hero. Primary request: a quiet old European-style street corner in soft late-afternoon sunlight, warm ochre plaster facade, dark green wooden window shutters, a small terracotta planter, long gentle shadows on pale stone pavement. Composition: landscape 3:2 with clear architectural lines, building corner to the right, open pavement and light to the left, a tactile candid 35mm photograph. Natural accurate colour and a little fine grain, not a heavily filtered picture. No people, no cars, no shop signage, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no identifiable famous location.
